english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is done in an impractical or unrealistic way.

examples.english: They planned the whole wedding unfeasibly, leaving no time for breaks.
examples.traditional: 佢哋唔切實際噉安排成個婚禮，連休息時間都冇。
